body:
## Context
Resolves #711.
`renderReport` iterates `d.options` unguarded, throwing `TypeError: d.options is not iterable` when a model returns a divergence entry lacking an `options` array, and `renderQuestionsJson` copies `undefined` options through into `--questions-json`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Normalize divergence entries in `packages/parallax/lib/scoring.mjs` (`normalizeDivergences`) and apply normalization in `runDivergenceAnalysis` (`packages/parallax/lib/modes.mjs`) as well as defensive normalization in `renderReport` and `renderQuestionsJson`.
- Repair missing or non-array `options` on divergence entries with a valid `point` string to `[]` (filtering out malformed option items) so option-less divergences still count toward `computeScore` and preserve `options: []` in `--questions-json`, while failing closed if `divergences` is non-empty but contains zero valid `point` entries.

## Verify
`node --test packages/parallax/test/scoring.test.mjs packages/parallax/test/modes.test.mjs packages/parallax/test/questions-json.test.mjs`
title: parallax: normalize divergences lacking options array (#711)
